title: Xbox Series X Console 1TB SSD Disc $949 Delivered / C&C / In-Store @ Target
body:
Deal: Xbox Series X Console 1TB SSD Disc $949 Delivered / C&C / In-Store @ Target

Plus RAM shortages aren't going away anytime soon, so I'd probably pounce on this.

[GameBunny] Yup my base Ps5 sitting and collecting dust too unfortunately. The way things are progressing, PC is the way to play games IMHO. But unfortunately unless you already have a gaming PC already by mid of last year, even PC gaming has become out of reach. Suddenly happy past times cost like an investment these days :(.
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] It's totally wild times hey. Then again my copy of Donkey Kong country 2 was $90 in 1996 so by today's prices that's like $200 per game. Gaming has always been kind of a luxury for me.
[Caped Baldy] I remember either ps2 or ps3 games being $120 new. Factoring inflation prices are good these days except for hardware and micro transactions.
[skittlebrau] Radeon 9070 XT when it was commonly around $850-900 is going to be hard to beat for value for a while I think. I’ve been very happy with mine running SteamOS.
No better time to opt out of the current annual cycle of ‘AAA’ titles and instead play older games at high frame rates and res.

I couldn't justify $950 for one. Even though that's a much better price than anywhere else at the moment.

Hell I don't need one but for that price I would buy it off you.
[asspray] @Aliensf: people sell it cause they don't use it… and then …
[cashews] I got great value out of mine from the 399 trade in deal near launch from EBGames.
Kids still use it all the time.
[hawktalk] @cashews I've had some decent luck over the years. First Xbox 360 was a free gift from a relative (had subsequent Xbox consoles from an insurance claim and another had the RROD). My last console was the LE Modern Warfare 3 console which I got extremely cheap when Dick Smith Powerhouse closed down. My Xbox One console "expensive" but offset by getting more free games with it (Forza 6 was the default game that came with the console, but I was given several other free game codes as the store had to get rid of them so I got more free games than I should have at the time).
I paid $220 for the Series S during COVID (should have been $399+ at the time) during the Series X shortage. Disappointed I couldn't get the Series X at launch, but it was only a matter of time before I got it. When I did I sold a few older games from my collection, which got the actual cost price down. When the 2tb Galaxy edition was announced, I pre-ordered it…. when it was release day, I traded in the Series S (hadn't touched it for years) and the Series X. The consoles themselves may have been expensive, but as I didn't pay full cost price for them, I didn't miss the money value. And the fact I got a $900 console for next to nothing afterward was a bold move on my part.
I was an Xbox addict for almost 19 years. I'd have the PS3, PS4 and PS5 to match the 360, Xbox One and Series S|X…. but 98% of my gaming time was on the Xbox. I've barely used the Series X in 2026, the downhill slide started early last year. I had a month long holiday, when I returned I found my subscription had lapsed…. with the drama about the price rising…. I wasn't motivated enough to resubscribe (and too lazy to go through my hoarding collection of Xbox Live game codes that would give me temporary respite). I did re-sub for a brief period (1 month in June, then 3 months toward the end of last year which was courtesy of a 3 month PC Game pass code I got from a 2024 laptop purchase).
I've barely used the console in 2026, just turned it on every 5 weeks to reload a game that has an automated process (Idle Wizard). Funny thing is I used to do this a lot in the ps3/ps4 era - log in monthly to claim the free games that interested me…. but most years I went MONTHS without powering on the consoles at all.
That said I'm actually buying GTA VI as my "return" to the platform. Force myself to use it more often…. balancing the likelihood that I wouldn't be able to play VI on the PS5 (V gives me bloodshot eyes and motion sickness on that console - but it doesn't on the Xbox or pc for that matter).
